title_quote: Where should I book a train ticket?

youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Taking the High-Speed Train
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用坐高鐵情境對話：從線上訂票選座取票、進站安檢找月台、車上用餐與到站提醒，到誤點補票、失物與出站接站（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Taking the High-Speed Train phrase pairs — booking tickets online, security and boarding, dining on board, delays, lost items and arrivals (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I book a train ticket?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd aɪ bʊk ə treɪn ˈtɪkɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我該去哪裡訂高鐵票？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the train app on your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə treɪn æp ɑn jʊr foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 用手機上的高鐵App就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need an account to book?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ən əˈkaʊnt tə bʊk?/
dialogue.zh: 訂票需要先註冊帳號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sign up with your ID.
dialogue.zh: 要的，用身分證註冊就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that code arrive yet?
dialogue.zh: 那個驗證碼到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, six numbers total.
dialogue.zh: 來了，一共六個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What date do you want to leave?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt deɪt du ju wɔnt tə liv?/
dialogue.zh: 你想哪天出發？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This Saturday morning, if possible.
dialogue.zh: 如果可以的話，這週六早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which city should we search for?
dialogue.zh: 我們該搜尋哪個城市？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taichung, about one hour away.
dialogue.zh: 台中，大約一小時車程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me the morning trains, please.
dialogue.zh: 請把早上的班次給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, six trains before nine.
dialogue.zh: 你看，九點前有六班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the 8:40 train sold out?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈeɪti ˈfɔrti treɪn soʊld aʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 八點四十那班賣光了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, seats are still open there.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，那班還有位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a standard seat?
dialogue.zh: 標準座多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's about forty US dollars.
dialogue.zh: 大約四十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is business class much more?
dialogue.zh: 商務座貴很多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nearly double the price.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，幾乎是兩倍價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's just take the standard one.
dialogue.zh: 我們就坐標準座吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, save the money.
dialogue.zh: 對，這樣還能省點錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you pick my seat for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju pɪk maɪ sit fər mi?/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我選座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Window or aisle, which do you like?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪndoʊ ɔr aɪəl wɪtʃ du ju laɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 靠窗還是走道，你喜歡哪邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love the window side.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡靠窗那一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, seat twelve A is free.
dialogue.zh: 好，12A是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll sit next to you this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɪt nɛkst tə ju ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 這次我要坐在你旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take seat twelve B.
dialogue.zh: 那就選12B吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the seats by the door convenient?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə sits baɪ ðə dɔr kənˈvinjənt?/
dialogue.zh: 靠近車門的座位方便嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're handy, but people pass by.
dialogue.zh: 方便是方便，但會有人走來走去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do any of these seats face forward?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈɛni ʌv ðiːz sits feɪs ˈfɔrwərd?/
dialogue.zh: 這些座位有向前的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, rows one through five face that way.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs roʊz wʌn θru faɪv feɪs ðæt weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有，一到五排都是向前的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I get carsick on trains sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 我有時坐火車會暈車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then hope row twelve faces that way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hoʊp roʊ twɛlv ˈfeɪsəz ðæt weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就希望十二排是朝前的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want a quiet car seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɔnt ə ˈkwaɪət kɑr sit/
dialogue.zh: 你要安靜車廂的座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, no phone calls there.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，那裡不能講電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these tickets easy to return?
dialogue.zh: 這些票之後好退嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but there's a small fee.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但會有一點手續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I change the date after paying?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tʃeɪndʒ ðə deɪt ˈæftər ˈpeɪɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 付款後還能改日期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, one free change only.
dialogue.zh: 可以，只有一次免費改票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How should I pay for the tickets?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ʃʊd aɪ peɪ fər ðə ˈtɪkəts/
dialogue.zh: 訂票我該怎麼付款？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Credit card is the fastest way.
dialogue.zh: 用信用卡是最快的方法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the app take Apple Pay?
dialogue.zh: 這個App支援Apple Pay嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just tap the pay button.
dialogue.zh: 有，按付款鍵就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our payment seems to be loading.
dialogue.zh: 我們那邊付款好像在載入。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait a moment, don't close it.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，先別關閉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did our booking go through?
dialogue.zh: 我們的訂票成功了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, look, here's the screen.
dialogue.zh: 成功了，你看這個畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read the trip details out loud.
dialogue.zh: 把行程明細唸出來聽聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday, eight forty, train one oh three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ eɪt ˈfɔrti treɪn wʌn oʊ θri/
dialogue.zh: 週六，八點四十，車次103。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are our seats confirmed already?
dialogue.zh: 我們的座位確認好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Confirmed, twelve A and twelve B.
dialogue.zh: 確認了，12A和12B。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we also print paper tickets?
dialogue.zh: 我們還要不要印紙本車票？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the QR code works fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə kjuː ɑr koʊd wɜrks faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不用，掃QR碼就能進站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I find my QR code?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ faɪnd maɪ kjuː ɑr koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 我要去哪裡找QR碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the app and tap my trips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ði æp ænd tæp maɪ trɪps/
dialogue.zh: 打開App點「我的行程」。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take a screenshot of it?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪk ə ˈskrinˌʃɑt ʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把它截圖存起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, just keep your phone charged.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但手機要保持有電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my phone dies at the gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf maɪ foʊn daɪz æt ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 要是我的手機在閘口沒電了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Print one at the station machines.
dialogue.zh: 在車站的自動售票機印一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What documents do the machines need?
dialogue.zh: 服務機需要什麼證件？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just scan your ID at the slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst skæn jʊr aɪˈdi æt ðə slɑt/
dialogue.zh: 把身分證放進掃描區就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get tickets for both of us?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ˈtɪkəts fər boʊθ ʌv ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 可以一次取我們兩個人的票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap print twice on screen.
dialogue.zh: 可以，畫面上按兩次列印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the machine eats my card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə məˈʃin its maɪ kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 機器萬一把身分證吃掉怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press help and wait a minute.
dialogue.zh: 按求助鍵，等一下看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a ticket receipt useful here?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡票根有用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it for your expense report.
dialogue.zh: 留著報帳的時候會用到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are both our seats in the same row?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr boʊθ ˈaʊər sits ɪn ðə seɪm roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個的座位在同一排嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both in row twelve, side by side.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, boʊθ ɪn roʊ twɛlv, saɪd baɪ saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 對，兩個都在十二排，相鄰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can kids ride the train free?
dialogue.zh: 小孩可以免費搭火車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under six usually ride free.
dialogue.zh: 六歲以下通常免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a discount for students?
dialogue.zh: 學生有優惠票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show your card at the counter.
dialogue.zh: 到櫃台出示學生證就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where inside is the ticket counter?
dialogue.zh: 票券櫃台在站內的哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left of the main entrance doors.
dialogue.zh: 正門進去左邊就是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the line usually?
dialogue.zh: 排隊通常要等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe ten minutes, just wait.
dialogue.zh: 大概十分鐘，等一下就輪到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd like to check my booking.
dialogue.zh: 我想確認一下我的訂票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show them your ID and phone.
dialogue.zh: 把身分證和手機給他們看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I change our seats at the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tʃeɪndʒ ˈaʊər sits æt ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在櫃台改座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk can fix that for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛsk kæn fɪks ðæt fər ju/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台可以幫你處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says changes cost nothing.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫改票不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, then we're all set.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那我們都準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my seat looks different now.
dialogue.zh: 等等，我的座位怎麼變了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app moved us to car four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp muvd ʌs tə kɑr fɔr/
dialogue.zh: App把我們改到第四車廂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the app send a new code?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ði æp sɛnd ə nu koʊd/
dialogue.zh: App有傳新的乘車碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, use this one today.
dialogue.zh: 有，今天就用這一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same seats, just a new code?
dialogue.zh: 座位不變，只是換新碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, everything else stays the same.
dialogue.zh: 對，其他都不變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should we reach the station?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm ʃʊd wi riːtʃ ðə ˈsteɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 我們幾點該到車站？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least forty minutes early.
dialogue.zh: 至少早四十分鐘到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we buy snacks before boarding?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在上車前買點零食嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The corner shop inside is open.
dialogue.zh: 站內的商店已經開門了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we still take the eight forty?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi stɪl teɪk ði eɪt ˈfɔrti/
dialogue.zh: 所以還是搭八點四十那班？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same as booked, train one oh three.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm æz bʊkt treɪn wʌn oʊ θri/
dialogue.zh: 跟訂好的一樣，車次103。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What station is our stop again?
dialogue.zh: 我們要下的車站是哪一站？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taichung, our fourth stop.
dialogue.zh: 台中，我們的第四站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And it leaves from gate seven?
dialogue.zh: 它是從七號閘口上車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, gate seven, check the app.
dialogue.zh: 對，七號口，你看App。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're ready, let's go pick up tickets.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr ˈrɛdi lɛts ɡoʊ pɪk ʌp ˈtɪkəts/
dialogue.zh: 我們準備好了，去取票吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get your bag ready, I'll lead the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt jʊr bæɡ ˈrɛdi aɪl lid ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 包拿好，我在前面帶路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're here, the east entrance.
dialogue.zh: 我們到了，從東側入口進。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow me, it's crowded inside.
dialogue.zh: 跟我走，裡頭人很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we line up for security?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi laɪn ʌp fər sɪˈkjʊrəti/
dialogue.zh: 安檢要在哪裡排隊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See the blue signs, that way.
dialogue.zh: 看到藍色牌子了嗎，往那邊走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This line is longer than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs laɪn ɪz ˈlɔŋɡɚ ðæn aɪ θɔt/
dialogue.zh: 這隊比我想像中的長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It moves fast, don't worry.
dialogue.zh: 隊伍動得很快，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I take my backpack off?
dialogue.zh: 我需要把背包脫下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, place it on the belt.
dialogue.zh: 要，放到傳送帶上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I put my water bottle?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ pʊt maɪ ˈwɔtər ˈbɑtəl/
dialogue.zh: 我的水瓶要放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It goes through with your bag.
dialogue.zh: 跟你的包一起過掃描就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to remove my shoes?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə rɪˈmuv maɪ ʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 我需要脫鞋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep your shoes on today.
dialogue.zh: 不用，今天鞋子穿著就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says to empty my pockets here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz tə ˈɛmpti maɪ ˈpɑkəts hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫著要把口袋清空。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phone, keys, coins, all in.
dialogue.zh: 手機、鑰匙、硬幣，全放進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the detector just beeped at me.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðə dɪˈtɛktər dʒʌst bipt æt mi/
dialogue.zh: 哦，偵測器剛剛對我響了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take off your belt and try again.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɔf jʊr bɛlt ænd traɪ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 把皮帶解下來再試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry for the delay, all set now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri fər ðə dɪˈleɪ ɔl sɛt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉耽擱了，現在沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, we all wait sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，大家都偶爾要等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they check your laptop bag?
dialogue.zh: 他們有檢查你的電腦包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They only looked at my umbrella.
dialogue.zh: 他們只看了看我的傘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're through, that wasn't bad.
dialogue.zh: 我們通過安檢了，一點都不難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? I told you it's easy.
dialogue.zh: 看吧，我說了很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I find a clean restroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ faɪnd ə klin ˈrɛstˌrum/
dialogue.zh: 哪裡有乾淨的洗手間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beside the coffee shop, second hall.
dialogue.zh: 咖啡廳旁邊，第二大廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's meet back here in ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts mit bæk hɪr ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 我們十分鐘後在這裡碰面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't be late, check your watch.
dialogue.zh: 別遲到，看一下你的表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which hall has our departure gate?
dialogue.zh: 我們那個檢票口在哪個大廳？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hall B, go up the escalator.
dialogue.zh: B大廳，搭電扶梯上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the screen lists five delayed trains.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə skriːn lɪsts faɪv dɪˈleɪd treɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 你看，螢幕上列了五班誤點的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours is not on that list.
dialogue.zh: 我們那班不在名單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see our gate number?
dialogue.zh: 你看到我們的閘口號碼了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gate seven, right across from us.
dialogue.zh: 七號口，就在我們對面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we sit while we wait here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi sɪt waɪl wi weɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 等待的時候可以在這裡坐一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These two seats look free.
dialogue.zh: 這兩個位子看起來是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my feet really need this.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的腳真的需要休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest, we still have time.
dialogue.zh: 休息一下，我們時間還夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the platform downstairs from here?
dialogue.zh: 月台是在這裡往下層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, go down after you scan through.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɡoʊ daʊn ˈæftər ju skæn θru/
dialogue.zh: 對，刷過票再往下走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is boarding open already?
dialogue.zh: 已經開放登車了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, they're calling our train.
dialogue.zh: 聽，廣播在叫我們那班了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen says boarding at gate seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin sɛz ˈbɔrdɪŋ æt ɡeɪt ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕顯示七號口開放登車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's ours, grab everything.
dialogue.zh: 是我們那班，東西全拿好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone's standing up at once.
dialogue.zh: 大家一下子就全站起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's stand in line, mind your bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts stænd ɪn laɪn maɪnd jʊr bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我們去排隊，看好你的包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scan your code flat on the reader.
dialogue.phonetic: /skæn jʊr koʊd flæt ɑn ðə ˈridər/
dialogue.zh: 把QR碼平放在掃描器上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It turned green, I'm through.
dialogue.zh: 燈變綠了，我進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone died right at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn daɪd raɪt æt ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我的手機剛剛在閘口沒電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use my phone, open your trips.
dialogue.zh: 用我的手機，打開你的行程頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A staff member waved us down the stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stæf ˈmɛmbər weɪvd ʌs daʊn ðə stɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 服務人員揮手叫我們下樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The train is waiting right there.
dialogue.zh: 高鐵就停在那邊等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, it's so much longer up close.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ɪts soʊ mʌtʃ ˈlɔŋɡɚ ʌp kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 哇，靠近了看真的好長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve cars, we need car four.
dialogue.zh: 十二節車廂，我們要到第四車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way is car four?
dialogue.zh: 第四車廂往哪邊走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep going past two doors from here.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ˈɡoʊɪŋ pæst tu dɔrz frʌm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 往前，經過兩個門再繼續走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arms are hurting from this suitcase.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɑrmz ɑr ˈhɜrɪŋ frʌm ðɪs ˈsutˌkeɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這個行李箱弄得我手好酸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, let me carry it a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr lɛt mi ˈkæri ɪt ə waɪl/
dialogue.zh: 來，我幫你拿一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're too kind, thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr tu kaɪnd θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你真好，太感謝了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friends help friends with heavy bags.
dialogue.zh: 朋友之間幫忙拿行李是應該的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This yellow line means stay back.
dialogue.zh: 這條黃線是要我們退後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand behind it until we board.
dialogue.zh: 上車前都站在線後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The doors slide open softly.
dialogue.zh: 車門輕輕地滑開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step up carefully, mind your feet.
dialogue.zh: 小心踏上來，注意腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, coming through, please.
dialogue.zh: 借過一下，麻煩讓我過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, my bag blocked the aisle.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我的包擋到了走道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Car four, this is our door.
dialogue.zh: 第四車廂，這是我們的門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Made it, nobody pushed us back.
dialogue.zh: 進來了，還好沒人擠我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do big suitcases go?
dialogue.zh: 大行李箱要放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a rack near the doors.
dialogue.zh: 車門旁邊有一個行李架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's full, only small bags fit.
dialogue.zh: 已經滿了，只能放小包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the end of the car instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ði ɛnd ʌv ðə kɑr ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 試試車廂最末端的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's space between those last seats.
dialogue.zh: 最後幾張椅子中間有空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide it in, perfect, it fits.
dialogue.zh: 塞進去，剛好，放得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's use the rack up top for these.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts juz ðə ræk ʌp tɑp fər ðiz/
dialogue.zh: 小包就放上面的行李架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift it in, I'll help push up.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ɪt ɪn aɪl hɛlp pʊʃ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 舉高放進去，我幫你推一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just be careful with my soft bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst bi ˈkɛrfəl wɪð maɪ sɔft bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 小心點，別壓壞我的軟包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's light, it won't crush anything.
dialogue.zh: 很輕的，不會壓壞東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found our seats, row twelve, by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ˈaʊər sits, roʊ twɛlv, baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 找到我們的位子了，十二排靠窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twelve A is mine, twelve B yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, twɛlv eɪ ɪz maɪn, twɛlv bi jʊrz/
dialogue.zh: 對，十二A是我的，十二B是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This space under the seat is tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs speɪs ˈʌndər ðə sit ɪz taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 座位下面這個空間好小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flatten it, then it slides right in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflætən ɪt ðɛn ɪt slaɪdz raɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 把它壓平，就滑得進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, now let me stretch my legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, naʊ lɛt mi strɛtʃ maɪ lɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 好，讓我伸一下腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, the person behind you is eating.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl, ðə ˈpɜrsən bɪˈhaɪnd ju ɪz ˈitɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 小心，你後面那個人正在吃東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a belt here on the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə bɛlt hɪr ɑn ðə saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 旁邊還有一條安全帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave that, trains don't need it.
dialogue.zh: 那個不用，火車不需要它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chair reclines with this lever.
dialogue.zh: 這個把手可以讓椅子往後躺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it gently, nice and slow.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕按，慢慢地就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This small table pulls right down.
dialogue.zh: 這個小桌板往下拉就放平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds your cup just fine.
dialogue.zh: 放你的杯子剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a power plug under the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ə ˈpaʊər plʌɡ ˈʌndər ðə sit/
dialogue.zh: 看，座位下面有個電源插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Charge your dead phone right now.
dialogue.zh: 趕快幫你沒電的手機充電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lights inside just dimmed a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪts ɪnˈsaɪd dʒʌst dɪmd ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 車廂裡面的燈剛剛變暗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means we're leaving soon.
dialogue.zh: 那表示我們快要出發了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A soft chime rang from the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sɔft tʃaɪm ræŋ frʌm ðə frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 車廂最前面輕輕響了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the conductor welcomes everyone aboard.
dialogue.zh: 現在車長在歡迎全體乘客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're moving, look at the platform.
dialogue.zh: 我們出發了，看月台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The platform is sliding backward slowly.
dialogue.zh: 月台緩緩往後滑過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The station disappeared around a curve.
dialogue.zh: 車站轉個彎就不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it's just fields and sky.
dialogue.zh: 現在只剩下田野和天空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest your bag flat on your lap.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst jʊr bæɡ flæt ɑn jʊr læp/
dialogue.zh: 把包平平放在腿上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, now we can finally relax.
dialogue.zh: 好了，我們終於可以放鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My stomach is making noises already.
dialogue.zh: 我的肚子已經在叫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cart will pass before long, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrt wɪl pæs bɪˈfɔr lɔŋ aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 推車一下就會經過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a dining car on this train?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈdaɪnɪŋ kɑr ɑn ðɪs treɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這班車有餐車廂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's in car six ahead.
dialogue.zh: 有，就在前面第六車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's walk up and take a look.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts wɔk ʌp ænd teɪk ə lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 我們走到前面去看看吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the seat backs as you go.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə sit bæks æz ju ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 走的時候抓穩椅背。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The menu card hangs on this hook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɛnju kɑrd hæŋz ɑn ðɪs hʊk/
dialogue.zh: 菜單就掛在這個鉤子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Could you read it for me, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju rid ɪt fər mi pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 可以唸給我聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They have noodles and boxed lunches.
dialogue.zh: 他們有麵和便當。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get me the beef noodles, please.
dialogue.zh: 幫我點牛肉麵好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything to drink with that?
dialogue.zh: 還要搭配什麼喝的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hot teas, no sugar.
dialogue.zh: 兩杯熱茶，不要糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we pay for food right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi peɪ fər fud raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在這裡付餐點的錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cart lady takes a phone scan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrt ˈleɪdi teɪks ə foʊn skæn/
dialogue.zh: 餐車服務人員只用手機掃碼收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The noodles smell really good.
dialogue.zh: 這麵聞起來真的很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the bowl with both hands.
dialogue.zh: 碗要用兩手端好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot tea spilled when the train turned.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt ti spɪld wɛn ðə treɪn tɜrnd/
dialogue.zh: 火車轉彎時熱茶灑出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use these napkins, I have two packs.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðiːz ˈnæpkɪnz, aɪ hæv tu pæks/
dialogue.zh: 用這些紙巾吧，我還帶了兩包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I brought peanuts in my bag too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brɔt ˈpidˌnʌts ɪn maɪ bæɡ tu/
dialogue.zh: 我包裡也帶了花生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, sharing makes it tastier.
dialogue.zh: 不錯耶，一起分享更好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they sell instant coffee too?
dialogue.zh: 他們也賣即溶咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hot or iced both work.
dialogue.zh: 有，熱的或冰的都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I rest my feet on that seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ rɛst maɪ fit ɑn ðæt sit/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把腳放到那個座位上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please don't, it bothers others.
dialogue.zh: 請不要，這樣會影響別人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your seat too close to mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz jʊr sit tu kloʊs tə maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你的座位會不會離我太近？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push back a bit, there we go.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ bæk ə bɪt ðɛr wi ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 往後一點，對了就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, did I hit your little table?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, dɪd aɪ hɪt jʊr ˈlɪtəl ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我撞到你的小桌板了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, nothing broke.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，什麼都沒壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This sun is right in my eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs sʌn ɪz raɪt ɪn maɪ aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這個太陽正照進我眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the shade down halfway, that helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ðə ʃeɪd daʊn ˈhæfˌweɪ, ðæt hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 窗簾拉下一半就舒服多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much better, it's cooler already.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，已經涼快一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The air is cold in this car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪ ɛr ɪz koʊld ɪn ðɪs kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 這一節車廂的冷氣好冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I borrow something warm from them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈbɑroʊ ˈsʌmθɪŋ wɔrm frʌm ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 我要跟他們借一條暖暖的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew keeps blankets in car one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kru kips ˈblæŋkɪts ɪn kɑr wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 工作人員在第一車廂放了毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, may I have a blanket?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi meɪ aɪ hæv ə ˈblæŋkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，可以給我一條毯子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, this one is clean.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，這條是乾淨的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two seats behind us face backward.
dialogue.zh: 我們後面有兩個座位是向後擺的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can turn them, push the lever down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn tɜrn ðɛm, pʊʃ ðə ˈlɛvər daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 可以轉的，把把手往下壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can rotate the whole chair?
dialogue.zh: 整張椅子都可以轉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but hold it, it spins fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bət hoʊld ɪt, ɪt spɪnz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但扶著點，它轉很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These seats even have footrests.
dialogue.zh: 這些座位居然還有腳踏板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, I'll rest both feet up here.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, aɪl rɛst boʊθ fit ʌp hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 好，我把兩隻腳都擱上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel sleepy after that lunch.
dialogue.zh: 吃完午餐後我好睏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, my eyes feel so heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu, maɪ aɪz fil soʊ ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我眼睛好睏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take a nap, I'll wake us both.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ə næp, aɪl weɪk ʌs boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 你睡一下，到站我叫我們兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This headrest is really soft, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過這個頭枕意外地軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long until we arrive?
dialogue.zh: 還多久才會到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About fifty minutes left now.
dialogue.zh: 現在還剩大約五十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set an alarm so we don't oversleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt æn əˈlɑrm soʊ wi doʊnt ˈoʊvɚslip/
dialogue.zh: 設個鬧鐘，免得我們睡過頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I set mine for twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 我把鬧鐘設在二十分鐘後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your headphones are leaking music.
dialogue.zh: 你的耳機在漏音樂出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I'll turn the volume down.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我把音量轉小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you mind if I make a call?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju maɪnd ɪf aɪ meɪk ə kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我講個電話你介意嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can talk at the end of the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn tɔk æt ði ɛnd ʌv ðə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 要講電話可以到車廂最尾端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello? Yes, we're on the train.
dialogue.zh: 喂？對，我們已經在車上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell them our arrival time.
dialogue.zh: 告訴他們我們抵達的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every tunnel drops the phone signal.
dialogue.zh: 每個隧道都會讓手機訊號斷掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's normal, it's back after one hill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈnɔrməl, ɪts bæk ˈæftər wʌn hɪl/
dialogue.zh: 很正常，過一個山坡就恢復了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here comes a long dark one.
dialogue.zh: 又要進一個又長又黑的隧道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My ears popped, swallow twice.
dialogue.zh: 我耳朵悶了，吞兩下口水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a river and some mountains!
dialogue.zh: 看，有河流還有山！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a photo before it's gone.
dialogue.zh: 快拍張照，一下就過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bridge makes the car shake a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə brɪdʒ meɪks ðə kɑr ʃeɪk ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 過橋的時候車廂會稍微晃一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold your cup, don't spill it.
dialogue.zh: 拿好你的杯子，別打翻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Another train just flew past our window.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈnʌðɚ treɪn dʒʌst flu pæst ˈaʊər ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 剛有另一班車從窗外飛快交會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole frame rattled, that was fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl freɪm ˈrætəld, ðæt wʌz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 整個窗框都喀啦響，好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need the restroom, hold my seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ðə ˈrɛstrum, hoʊld maɪ sit/
dialogue.zh: 我急著上洗手間，幫我顧位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's just past car five, left.
dialogue.zh: 在第五車廂過去左邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it occupied? The light is red.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈɑkjʊˌpaɪd ðə laɪt ɪz rɛd/
dialogue.zh: 有人在裡面嗎？燈是紅的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wait for the green light.
dialogue.zh: 對，等綠燈亮了再進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? This lock turns from the inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /si? ðɪs lɑk tɜrnz frʌm ði ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 你看，這個鎖可以在裡面上鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn the little latch to red.
dialogue.zh: 把小門栓轉到紅色就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's even soap and a warm dryer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ˈivɪn soʊp ænd ə wɔrm draɪər/
dialogue.zh: 居然還有肥皂和暖風吹風機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They clean it at every single stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ klin ɪt æt ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 他們每一站都會打掃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The baby across started crying.
dialogue.zh: 對面的小寶寶開始哭鬧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His mom is rocking him now.
dialogue.zh: 媽媽正在輕輕哄他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Babies on trains are so cute.
dialogue.zh: 火車上的小寶寶真可愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some people seem annoyed though.
dialogue.zh: 不過有些人看起來有點煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The announcement chime is on again.
dialogue.zh: 廣播提示音又響了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, it's about our next stop.
dialogue.zh: 注意聽，是關於下一站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it say we change trains there?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɪt seɪ wi tʃeɪndʒ treɪnz ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 它有說我們要在那邊換車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only some passengers get off.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，只有一些乘客要下車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the screen shows Taichung in blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə skriːn ʃoʊz ˌtaɪˈdʒʊŋ ɪn blu/
dialogue.zh: 現在螢幕把台中顯示成藍色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means one more station left.
dialogue.zh: 那就是說只剩一站了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we sitting near the doors?
dialogue.zh: 我們坐得離門近嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we'll step off first.
dialogue.zh: 對，我們可以到站先下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come on, sleepy head, almost there.
dialogue.zh: 醒一下，瞌睡蟲，快到囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mm? Already? What did I miss?
dialogue.zh: 嗯？已經了嗎？我錯過了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just tunnels, and one snack cart.
dialogue.zh: 只有隧道和一次餐點車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing sad, I slept great.
dialogue.zh: 沒什麼可惜的，我睡得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check under your seat before we rise.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ˈʌndər jʊr sit bɪˈfɔr wi raɪz/
dialogue.zh: 站起來之前先看一下座位底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My charger cable is still here.
dialogue.zh: 我的充電線還在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Charge it fast before we arrive.
dialogue.zh: 到站前趕快把手機充飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighty percent, good enough now.
dialogue.zh: 已經八成，夠用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole car is slowing down now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl kɑr ɪz ˈsloʊɪŋ daʊn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 整列車現在慢下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's our station coming up.
dialogue.zh: 我們那站就在前面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gather everything, and take our trash.
dialogue.zh: 東西收一收，垃圾也帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bags go out before we stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bæɡz ɡoʊ aʊt bɪˈfɔr wi stænd/
dialogue.zh: 好，先讓行李出去再站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand up only when doors open.
dialogue.zh: 門開了以後再站起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rules keep us safe here.
dialogue.zh: 這些規定是為了安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why did the train just stop?
dialogue.zh: 火車怎麼突然停下來了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The brakes squealed really loudly.
dialogue.zh: 剎車發出好大一聲尖響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen says delayed fifteen minutes.
dialogue.zh: 螢幕顯示誤點十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sigh, my meeting is at noon.
dialogue.zh: 唉，我中午有個會議。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call them and say you're late.
dialogue.zh: 打電話跟他們說你會遲到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My phone shows no signal now.
dialogue.zh: 我的手機現在完全沒訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It could grow to half an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kʊd ɡroʊ tə hæf ən ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 可能會拖到半小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least they tell us the truth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ət liːst ðeɪ tɛl ʌs ðə truθ/
dialogue.zh: 至少他們誠實告訴我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a delay certificate?
dialogue.zh: 可以開一張誤點證明嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the conductor when we arrive.
dialogue.zh: 到站的時候問車長就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They said it prints for free.
dialogue.zh: 他們說那個是免費列印。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect proof for my office.
dialogue.zh: 剛好拿去給公司當證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, my ticket code vanished.
dialogue.zh: 糟了，我的乘車碼不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the app crash on your phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ði æp kræʃ ɑn jʊr foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 你的App在手機上當機了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't reopen it at all.
dialogue.zh: 我完全沒辦法再打開它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show your booking number instead.
dialogue.zh: 改給他們看訂票編號吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One tap, and the staff found it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tæp, ænd ðə stæf faʊnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 點一下，服務人員就找到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you won't need a new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju woʊnt nid ə nu wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 所以你不用另外補票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I lost that too?
dialogue.zh: 如果連那個也弄丟了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look it up by your ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ lʊk ɪt ʌp baɪ jʊr aɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 他們可以用身分證幫你查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops, I sat in the wrong row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊps, aɪ sæt ɪn ðə rɔŋ roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，我坐到別的排了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did, this is row thirteen.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，這裡是十三排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ours is twelve B, right by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊərz ɪz twɛlv bi, raɪt baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我們的是十二B，就在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then walk back, the train is still late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɔk bæk, ðə treɪn ɪz stɪl leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那走回去吧，火車還是晚點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody boards without a ticket.
dialogue.zh: 沒有人可以無票上車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, staff check every row.
dialogue.zh: 不過乘務員還是會逐排檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See those folks? They missed boarding.
dialogue.zh: 看到那幾個人了嗎？他們沒擠上車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now they must buy new tickets.
dialogue.zh: 他們現在得要重新買票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they get money back?
dialogue.zh: 那舊票還能退錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only half of it, most likely.
dialogue.zh: 多半只能退一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The delay is now forty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 現在已經誤點四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People pace up and down.
dialogue.zh: 大家在走道上來回踱步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone behind us keeps sighing loudly.
dialogue.zh: 我們後面有人一直很大聲地嘆氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone fears missing connections.
dialogue.zh: 每個人都怕轉乘趕不上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they transfer at the next stop?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðeɪ trænsˈfɚ æt ðə nɛkst stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 他們可以在下一站換車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask them to find another route.
dialogue.zh: 請他們幫你找別的路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They handed out water for free.
dialogue.zh: 他們免費發了礦泉水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small sorry for the wait.
dialogue.zh: 算是為等待小小道歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finally, the train moves again.
dialogue.zh: 終於，火車又開始移動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone clapped, how funny.
dialogue.zh: 大家居然鼓掌，真好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, where is my wallet?
dialogue.zh: 糟了，我錢包呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check your other coat pocket first.
dialogue.zh: 先摸一下你另一邊的外套口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not here, I'm so worried now.
dialogue.zh: 不在這裡，我現在好擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you use it at the cart?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju juz ɪt æt ðə kɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 你買餐點的時候用過它嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, right at the snack cart.
dialogue.zh: 有，就在餐點推車那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe it's on that tray there.
dialogue.zh: 說不定放在那個托盤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No tray there, only my dropped headphones.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ treɪ ðɛr, ˈoʊnli maɪ drɑpt ˈhɛdˌfoʊnz/
dialogue.zh: 托盤上沒有，只有我掉的耳機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reach deep, it's dark under there.
dialogue.zh: 伸手進去，座位底下黑黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found them, dusty but working.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，雖然髒髒但能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky, one thing found today, though.
dialogue.zh: 好歹找回來一樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I report a lost wallet?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ rɪˈpɔrt ə lɔst ˈwɑlət/
dialogue.zh: 遺失錢包該怎麼登記？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill this form at lost property.
dialogue.zh: 到失物招領處填這張表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Describe it: brown, small, leather.
dialogue.zh: 描述一下：棕色、小巧、皮革。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Were there cards inside it?
dialogue.zh: 裡面有沒有放卡片？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ID and two bank cards.
dialogue.zh: 有身分證和兩張銀行卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They'll call you when found.
dialogue.zh: 找到的話他們會打電話給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do lost things come back often?
dialogue.zh: 遺失的東西常常會回來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most small items turn up.
dialogue.zh: 大部分小東西都會出現。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone left an umbrella on the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn lɛft æn ʌmˈbrɛlə ɑn ðə sit/
dialogue.zh: 有人把一把傘落在座位上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it here for the station staff.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt hɪr fər ðə ˈsteɪʃən stæf/
dialogue.zh: 留在這裡交給車站人員吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're arriving, stand up slowly.
dialogue.zh: 要到站了，慢慢站起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check every pocket, twice.
dialogue.zh: 每個口袋都檢查，查兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The doors hiss and open wide.
dialogue.zh: 車門咻一聲往兩邊開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step out, mind the gap again.
dialogue.zh: 下車時再小心一次縫隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, where is our big suitcase now?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, wɛr ɪz ˈaʊər bɪɡ ˈsutˌkeɪs naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我們的大行李箱在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stayed in the last row space.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt steɪd ɪn ðə læst roʊ speɪs/
dialogue.zh: 它還留在最後一排的空位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: People push past with big cases.
dialogue.zh: 大家推著大行李箱經過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep near the wall, this way.
dialogue.zh: 靠近牆邊走，這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, by those end seats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt ɪz, baɪ ðoʊz ɛnd sits/
dialogue.zh: 在那裡，就在最後的座位旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift with your legs, keep your back straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft wɪð jʊr lɛɡz, kip jʊr bæk streɪt/
dialogue.zh: 用腿部力量舉，腰別彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we go to exit?
dialogue.zh: 我們要去哪裡出站？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the exit signs downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 沿著出站指標下樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap your ticket at the gate.
dialogue.zh: 在閘口上拍一下車票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine got stuck, hit the call button.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɡɑt stʌk, hɪt ðə kɔl ˈbʌtən/
dialogue.zh: 我的卡住了，按那個呼叫鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The staff waved us right through.
dialogue.zh: 站務人員揮手讓我們直接過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exit one or exit two?
dialogue.zh: 要走一號出口還是二號？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One faces the bus stop.
dialogue.zh: 一號出口對著公車站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two has taxis waiting there.
dialogue.zh: 二號那邊排滿了計程車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's leave by number two then.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就從二號口離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car lane looks jammed right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑr leɪn lʊks dʒæmd raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 外面的車道現在看起來塞爆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is picking us up today?
dialogue.zh: 今天誰會來接我們？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My aunt, she's by the pillar.
dialogue.zh: 我阿姨，她在柱子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Raise your hand, she can't see us.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪz jʊr hænd, ʃi kænt si ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 舉高手，她還看不到我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's waving back, look there!
dialogue.zh: 她也揮手回來了，看！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she bring the little luggage cart?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ʃi brɪŋ ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈlʌɡɪdʒ kɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 她有推那個小行李車來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's parked by the wall.
dialogue.zh: 有，就停在牆壁旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How was the ride, tell me.
dialogue.zh: 路上怎樣，說給我聽聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smooth, except for one delay.
dialogue.zh: 很平穩，除了那次誤點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You look tired from traveling.
dialogue.zh: 你看起來坐車坐累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but I'm happy.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，但我很快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the hotel far from here?
dialogue.zh: 飯店離這裡遠不遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A short drive with my aunt.
dialogue.zh: 坐我阿姨的車一會兒就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm already dozing sitting up.
dialogue.zh: 我坐著都快打瞌睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest now, we'll get there.
dialogue.zh: 先休息一下，一會兒就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for helping today.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你今天一路的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, that's what friends do.
dialogue.zh: 別客氣，朋友就該這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next trip we fly, deal?
dialogue.zh: 下次旅行我們搭飛機，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the train was really fun.
dialogue.zh: 不要嘛，火車其實很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was a good ride from start to end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ə ɡʊd raɪd frʌm stɑrt tə ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 這趟車從頭到尾都算順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best trip ever. Now let's go eat.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst trɪp ˈɛvər. naʊ lɛts ɡoʊ it/
dialogue.zh: 最棒的一趟了，現在先去吃東西。
